head: 31babe87a7ef1e40a0d4bedc523077e7a45d63ab
authority: Only original M06 planning envelope and own board evidence. User-provided AGENTS workflow applies; repository AGENTS.md absent. No product edits, new dependencies or architecture approval.
confirmed: Validate version, integrity, references and target path safety before ESS/BIN import
Format/integrity/path failures block; only missing external dependency may be explicitly accepted as incomplete/pending binding
One merge modifies one target document plus necessary assets/references only
Cancellation/failure restores full target and preserves source BIN
Uncertain matching IDs pause affected items; no name guessing or silent remapping
One successful merge equals one Undo; failed/cancelled unapplied operation adds no history
BIN restore as new project is separate from merge and has no cross-document Undo

observations: Legacy unpackSgbBinary performs bounded-offset truncation checks but assigns map[name] directly, decodes entries as UTF-8 text and returns without an explicit final-offset equality check. Static inspection does not establish full BIN safe-import compliance.
Legacy packSgbBinary layout is a custom SGB1 container, not the proposed versioned BIN manifest with assets. Do not silently relabel it as BIN.

HOST adopt_project_document adopts an existing project-local reference and persists manifest; its comment explicitly disclaims cross-process CAS. Adoption is not content copy, safe extraction or compound merge.
Current HOST dependency list contains no approved ZIP decoder. Archive choice/version and decoder limits remain to be frozen. No package lookup or dependency addition performed.

findings.issue: Container-level malformed data and absent internal entry cannot take the incomplete-external-dependency exception.
findings.next: Separate BlockingValidationFailure from MissingExternalDependency in exact outcome model.

findings.issue: Validation then source reopen or target mutation permits time-of-check/time-of-use drift.
findings.next: Freeze verified immutable source capture, target revision binding and commit exclusion; generic write_atomic is not multi-content transaction.

findings.issue: Per-entry map overwrite and unchecked ambiguous layouts in a legacy parser cannot be reused as a complete safety contract.
findings.next: Versioned parser contract rejects duplicate/casefold/prefix/link/unknown-size ambiguity before mutation; preserve legacy compatibility as a separate bounded reader.

findings.issue: Existing broad candidate envelope omits exact validation DTO, archive resource caps and transactional failure seam.
findings.next: Propose isolated validation/planning first; do not build extraction or merge now.

architecture_proposal.hexagonal: UI/Test -> Tauri input -> DispatchHost -> HOST inspect/prepare/apply -> WORK pure import decision policy; HOST -> immutable source reader / decoder / safe staged transaction abstractions <- native/archive adapters.
architecture_proposal.module_dependencies: M01 identities + M04 document transaction/history + M05 material references -> M06 plan bound to exactly one target. M07 sees only completed or fully rolled-back document revision, never intermediate extraction.
architecture_proposal.ownership: Package bytes are immutable external input; target document owner remains SSOT. M06 plan/diff/validation report is a projection. Decoder cannot mutate documents or approve missing dependencies.
architecture_proposal.mutation: Inspect and prepare are read-only. Confirm authorizes only bound, previewed changes via target transaction. No UI-to-FS, direct package execution or hidden additional target.
architecture_proposal.transaction: Validated source snapshot -> complete temporary graph/reference plan -> explicit confirmation -> recheck source identity and target revision/safety -> stage owned bytes -> single-document coordinated commit/history -> receipt. Failure before commit preserves original; uncertain rollback keeps recovery evidence and blocks destructive follow-up. Exact transaction seam must be separately approved.
forbidden: Treat incomplete internal manifest as optional external dependency

recommended_defaults_not_approved.container: Keep existing ESS and legacy SGB1 reader contracts separate; BIN versioned manifest/container selection remains pending exact proposal, not auto-adopt ZIP.
recommended_defaults_not_approved.external_dependency: External references carry explicit logical identity and pending-binding state; no automatic network download, mount or install.
recommended_defaults_not_approved.bounds: Specify compressed bytes, expanded bytes, per-entry bytes, entry count, nesting and path length before parser Skeleton. Every cap needs max-1/max/max+1 fixtures. Numeric defaults are not invented as approved in this review.
recommended_defaults_not_approved.first_slice: Pure decision/plan validation may be isolated without actual archive extraction, but exact types/signatures and file envelope must be approved before Skeleton.
